note: `reason` is REQUIRED: a retirement is audited with why.
Badges are addressed by BadgeId, never by their badge group's identifier; the group goes with the badge.
There is no partial retirement: the awards are always kept (VTI-BDG-005), so no member says whether to.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
A retired badge is answered with its `state` `retired`; the response is the shared Badge shape and admits no other state value.
